subject: Renewal check: usage velocity + term options (Playgram)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@playgram.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@playgram.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Usage spike + renewal review

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well — quick note from our side. We ran into a couple of unexpected token spikes over the last six weeks as the recommendations feature rolled out to a broader cohort. A few details: 

- May 15–June 15: average daily tokens increased ~3.8x versus the prior window.
- Peak days (2): close to 6x typical run-rate (we attached the CSV with daily breakdown).
- Latency sensitivity on short-chat endpoints has started to affect user flows (a handful of timeouts).

We have a renewal coming up in August and want to evaluate options for short-term capacity smoothing and a longer-term commit to lock in economics. Can we set a time to review: usage trends, ROI impact, and term/commit options?

Attached: playgram_usage_may_jun.csv (CSV)

Primary asks:
1) Quick sanity-check of the spike (is this expected behavior when we scale recommendations?).
2) Cost projection if we keep current mix vs switch some traffic to a cheaper model variant.
3) Available short-term burst credit or pilot options to avoid UX regression before renewal.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform
Playgram
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@playgram.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage spike + renewal review

Samir — thanks for the data and the clear asks. Appreciate the attached breakdown. High-level thoughts from a quick pass:

- Spike pattern looks consistent with broader adoption of a heavier prompt mix (more context per request) — KV cache hit-rate drops and that increases per-request cost.
- We can run a short quantization pilot on a subset of inference to reduce cost per token without changing model quality for recommendation prompts.
- Short-term: we can offer a 30-day burst credit to cover peak days while we validate mitigation. Long-term: a stepped commit with headroom and a dedicated burst lane is likely the right play.

I copied Ben to put together concrete pricing options and a preliminary ROI recap. I've also sketched a one-pager (attached) showing the delta between current spend and two commit scenarios.

Proposed next step: 30-min review this week — Wed or Thu preferred. Share times that work and we'll lock it.

Attachments: playgram_roi_recap.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@playgram.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Playgram renewal options and pricing (pre-read)

Hi Samir — following Grace's note, attaching a more concrete quote and two proposal paths:

Option A — Short-term commit + burst credit:
- 3-month stepped commit (baseline = current run-rate * 1.2)
- One-off 30-day burst credit covering estimated peak excess (~$12k)
- Retains hosted API, no infra changes

Option B — 12-month reserved + optimization pilot:
- 12-month commit with quarterly true-ups; volume discount applied at 6mo and 12mo marks
- Dedicated burst lane and quantization pilot for recommendation endpoints (we expect ~20–30% token cost reduction on pilot traffic)
- SLA uplift available for an additional fee

Attached: PLG-quote-v2.pdf (PDF) — contains line-level pricing, estimated per-1M-token cost matrix for common model families, and a simple ROI table using your May–June usage.

Deal id for tracking: PLG-2027-033

If useful, I can also produce a per-endpoint cost split (chat vs recommendations) to help you determine where to route traffic to cheaper variants.

Short availability for a review call: Wed 6/30 10:00–11:30 or Thu 7/1 09:00–12:00 PDT.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@playgram.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@playgram.com>, Legal <legal@playgram.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Playgram renewal options and pricing (pre-read)

Ben / Grace — thanks for the fast turnaround and the materials. A few quick clarifying questions before the call:

1) Can you confirm the effective per-1M-token rates for Option A vs Option B (line-items please) — our CFO wants a clean comparison for the renewal deck.
2) What are the SLA targets for the dedicated burst lane (p95 latency, availability)?
3) We need the SOC 2 Type II evidence to share with our Security team — is the report the one at the link below?
4) If we proceed with Option B, what's the expected timeline to stand up the quantization pilot and who owns model validation?

Also, we will want DocuSign-ready terms (standard Redwood renewal + Appendix for dedicated lane). Can you send a draft if we move forward after the call?

Quoted for context: "Attached: PLG-quote-v2.pdf"

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
